top_choice_rationale: P003 pairs two achievements that are each mature and cleanly attributable on scientific grounds: the determined and independently confirmed atomic structure of the nitrogenase FeMo cofactor with its central carbide (Rees, Einsle), kept to structure rather than the unresolved mechanism, and Liu-only base editing as a programmed chemical conversion of a base without double-strand breaks, with directed evolution of the deaminase. It stays within the three-laureate cap with an exact allocation and a defensible citation scope for each part. Nitrogenase alone (P005) is my next choice, then Liu alone, then the degrader prize, whose credit is split between PROTAC and glue strands; the phase-separation pairing is least mature.
